fusions.name: Under Hoof
fusions.desc: Pins a target at or below 25% health under your hooves, dealing 26 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Round-Up
fusions.desc: Gallops a tight circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Closing Rails
fusions.desc: Closes a pen 7 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward, slowing anything it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Penned Quarry
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 10 seconds.
